Cu.description_en: The number of CUs that last took effect for the EventHouse Runtime
Cu.description_zh: EventHouse Runtime 最后成功生效的 CU 数量
Cu.title: CU 数量

ErrorCode.description_en: The stable error code returned when the creation or specification change operation fails
ErrorCode.description_zh: 创建或变配失败时返回的稳定错误码
ErrorCode.title: 操作错误码

ErrorMessage.description_en: The desensitized error message returned when the creation or specification change operation fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 创建或变配失败时返回的脱敏错误信息
ErrorMessage.title: 操作错误信息

Name.description_en: The name of the EventHouse Runtime. Typically set to default in the initial phase
Name.description_zh: EventHouse Runtime 名称。首期通常为 default
Name.title: 名称

Progress.description_en: The progress of the current creation or specification change operation. Valid values: 0 to 100
Progress.description_zh: 当前创建或变配操作的进度，取值范围为 0 到 100
Progress.title: 操作进度

Stage.description_en: The current stage of the creation or specification change operation
Stage.description_zh: 当前创建或变配操作所处阶段
Stage.title: 操作阶段

Status.description_en: The current status of the EventHouse Runtime. RUNNING indicates that the Runtime is ready and can accept queries. Valid values: CREATING, RUNNING, UPDATING, RECOVERING, CLOSED, CREATE_FAILED, and UPDATE_FAILED
Status.description_zh: EventHouse Runtime 当前状态。RUNNING 表示 Runtime 已就绪且可以承接查询。可能值为 CREATING、RUNNING、UPDATING、RECOVERING、CLOSED、CREATE_FAILED、UPDATE_FAILED
Status.title: Runtime 状态

TargetCu.description_en: The target number of CUs during creation, specification change, or the corresponding failed state. This parameter is not returned when the Runtime is running stably
TargetCu.description_zh: 创建、变配或对应失败状态下的目标 CU 数量，稳定运行时不返回
TargetCu.title: 目标 CU 数量

description_en: Queries the list of EventHouse runtimes
description_zh: 查询 EventHouse Runtime 列表
name: ListEventHouseRuntimes

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of runtimes to return per page. If this parameter is not specified or set to 0, the default value 20 is used. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页最多返回的 Runtime 数量。未传或传 0 时使用默认值 20，最大值为 100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: Not required for the first query. For subsequent queries, use the NextToken returned in the previous response. An empty value indicates that no more pages are available
parameters.help_zh: 首次查询无需传入。后续查询使用上一次响应返回的 NextToken；为空表示没有下一页
parameters.name: next_token

Code.description_en: The response code. Success indicates that the operation was successful
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功
Code.title_en: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功
Code.title_zh: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功

MaxResults.title_en: 本次请求使用的最大结果数
MaxResults.title_zh: 本次请求使用的最大结果数

NextToken.title_en: 下一页令牌，为空表示没有下一页
NextToken.title_zh: 下一页令牌，为空表示没有下一页

Message.description_en: The message returned by the operation

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the operation was successful
